selection_basis: Macro-F1, wetland-specific precision/recall/F1, class confusion and model complexity.
limitations: Comparison uses one buffered spatial split.
150 m separation does not prove spatial independence.
Wetland/Paddy/Vegetation spectral confusion remains a key research concern.
Four source sample-name/year mismatches remain documented as temporal-reference uncertainty.
No held-out test observations were used.
